name: Pressure gauge wall panel
brief: MK-162 Pressure gauge wall panel: two big round dials (air and power) behind glass, with chunky needles pointing at painted green, white and red arcs, fed by a pipe with a valve wheel and a little amber "check me" lamp. The diegetic replacement for an air meter: Abbie walks up and reads the wall.

rounds.t: First build from the pack style and the Faceted Hero rules, no Midjourney pick yet.
